results.detail: The pipeline test runs skillz run end to end on a paragraph fixture in a temporary directory with no model runner on PATH, asserts every stage wrote its JSON report under .factory/, the evaluation stage records skipped: no runner, a version exists in awaiting-approval state, nothing was installed, and the Markdown summary names each stage's verdict; the README has a quickstart a new user can follow and a pipeline diagram listing the stages in order including the human approval gate; skills/skill-factory/SKILL.md is a short, valid skill telling Claude Code or Codex how to drive skillz
